- Login when needed, for any website: if a download fails and a login could help, vd asks "Jetzt einloggen?", opens a browser window, saves the login and retries automatically (GUI asks too)
- Logins are saved per website: `vd login --list` shows them, `vd logout SITE` removes one, `vd logout` removes all
- No login prompt for DRM-protected videos (Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video): a clear message instead
- New `--no-login-prompt` option
